December 10, 2018 

The Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC  20543

Re: Smith v. Berryhill, No. 17-1606

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The petition for a writ of certiorari in the above case was granted on November 2, 2018; and 
petitioner’s opening brief is therefore due on December 17, 2018. 

Petitioner respectfully requests a short extension of the briefing schedule, as follows: 

Petitioner’s brief, due December 19, 2018 

Amicus’s brief, due January 22, 2019. 

Counsel for respondent and Amicus consent to this request. Also, the parties recognize that this 
case may be set for argument in the first week of the Court’s February sitting. 

Thank you for your consideration of this matter. 

Sincerely, 

/s/ Andrew J. Pincus 
Counsel for Petitioner
